name: bmw_n52b30
source: Engine garage P10: BMW N52B30 (2005-2009, 195 kW version) - a 3.0 L DOHC inline six with Valvetronic continuously variable intake lift, as a lumped cycle-model description; every runtime map is GENERATED at load, one complete set per intake lift node (cam part ../cams/bmw_n52b30_valvetronic.json, lift strategy in ../ecus/bmw_n52b30.json). Cited: bore x stroke 85.0 x 88.0 mm, 2996 cm3, compression ratio 10.7, intake valve 34.2 mm, exhaust valve 29 mm (https://mymotorlist.com/engines/bmw/n52b30/, a secondary page); 195 kW at 6600 rpm and 315 N*m at 2750-4250 rpm, 7000 rpm maximum speed, DOHC 4 valves per cylinder, double VANOS, electronic throttle, firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_N52). Rod, runner, ports, plenum, throttle, spark, lambda, friction and the rest are [AS] or rules copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json; nothing is fitted to the published ratings or to any dyno curve (the comparison is reported, tests/unit/test_lift_family.cpp). The 3-stage DISA intake of the higher-output versions and the double-VANOS phasing are not modelled - fixed cam centre lines.
geometry_source: [C] bore 85.0 mm, stroke 88.0 mm, 2996 cm3, 6 cylinders: https://mymotorlist.com/engines/bmw/n52b30/ and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_N52.
intake_manifold_volume_source: [AS] plenum = 1.2 x V_d (2.99562 L), the i7c plan rule used for the A25A (engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json); no N52 plenum volume found.
throttle_body_source: [AS] bore 76 mm: the K20A's cited 62 mm (engines/honda_k20a_dc5.json) scaled by sqrt(2996/1998) = 75.9 mm, no N52 throttle bore found; discharge coefficient 0.8 and the area-fraction curve copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json.
throttle_input_source: [C] electronic throttle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_N52); Valvetronic keeps it for idle, vacuum and limp-home (fenderbender, Scot Manna 2017, see the ECU part).

cycle.source: Engine garage P10: lumped (no pipe blocks) C15a cycle description of the BMW N52B30; per-key sources below. The intake lift family and the exhaust lift come from the cam part.
cycle.rod_mm_source: [AS] 144.35 mm centre-to-centre, the figure commonly quoted for the N52 (not verified against a citable page); l/r = 3.28.
cycle.intake_valve_d_mm_source: [C] intake 34.2 mm, exhaust 29 mm: https://mymotorlist.com/engines/bmw/n52b30/ (a secondary page).
cycle.runner_length_mm_source: [AS] the A25A rule (engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json): quarter-wave period 4L/a = the full-lift intake-open time (255 deg [C]) at 3500 rpm, the middle of the cited 2750-4250 rpm torque plateau [C], a = 340.29 m/s -> L = 1033.0 mm. Diameter: runner flow area = the total intake valve head area (2 x 34.2 mm heads -> 48.37 mm) [AS]. No N52 runner length is published here; the real base-engine manifold has no DISA.
cycle.intake_port_cc_source: [AS] the A25A rule: 80 mm x the total intake valve head area (1837.3 mm2); 250 mm x the total exhaust valve head area (1321.0 mm2).
cycle.cd_vs_l_over_d_source: [AS] copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json (Heywood 1988 Fig. 6-19 shape, recalled); the small-lift end (l/d 0.005 at 0.18 mm) is the curve's own l/d = 0 value.
cycle.wiebe_source: [AS] copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json: burn duration 40.3205 deg and ignition delay 3.8632 deg are that file's [D] values from the MIT 2.61 lecture 9 'modern fast-burn' figures, applied unchanged at every lift (the faster burn the high in-cylinder velocity of a small Valvetronic lift gives is not modelled); Wiebe a 5, m 2, CA50 at MBT 8 deg ATDC are the descriptor defaults.
cycle.friction_source: [AS] the F4 FMEP polynomial of engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json (fitted on a third engine, the EPA 2013 Ecotec LCV motored rows) applied unchanged; Valvetronic's own valvetrain friction is not modelled.
cycle.grid_source: [AS] idle to the 7000 rpm limit with a node at the cited 6600 rpm power speed; 20-100 kPa with a 95 kPa node (Valvetronic part load runs the manifold a few kPa below ambient).

fields_source: [AS] inertia 0.15 kg*m^2; breakaway 35 N*m (>= the F4 friction at rest, 15.9 N*m); starter stall torque 180 N*m (the A25A file's 140 N*m scaled for the larger engine). The state-machine speeds live in the ECU part.
fuels_source: [AS] EN 228 E5/E10 (the European N52 runs on 95 RON premium).
